name: Algolia Free Tier Search API Reselling
rejection_reason: ToS §4.5(m) explicitly prohibits 'sell, resell, license, sublicense, distribute, redistribute, rent, or lease' except when integrated into own offerings with additional functionality. §9.2 grants 'non-transferable, non-sublicensable' license. Pure proxy/pooling reselling model violates both clauses. Value-added exception requires product development beyond zero-capital infrastructure arbitrage.
tos_evidence: §4.5(h): shall not make Services available to anyone other than Subscriber's own personnel or end users
§4.5(m): shall not sell, resell, license, sublicense, distribute, redistribute, rent, or lease the Services except as integrated with its own offerings
risks: Direct ToS violation for pure reselling/proxy models
Value-added exception requires product development (not zero-capital arbitrage)
Enforcement risk: API key sharing detectable via usage patterns
next_steps: REJECTED - Do not promote to TIER1
